title: Evaluating Bias in LLMs for Job-Resume Matching: Gender, Race, and Education

live_model.evidence: "The models selected for evaluation include OpenAI's GPT-3.5-turbo, GPT-4-turbo, and GPT-4o" (Sec. 3.5); "newer models ... perform on par with GPT-4-turbo and GPT-4o" (Sec. 4.1, reading values off Figure 2)

prompt.location: Sec. 3 (matching-decision task described), Appendix C (name substitutions)
prompt.note: Resume/job-description matching prompt is described but not quoted verbatim.

claim.metric: none printed for GPT-4-turbo specifically (ROC AUC and gender/race bias % are read off Figure 2, given only as rounded approximations like ~0.90 for a group of models)

data.source: Synthetic resumes/job descriptions with substituted names across 8 locales (Sec. 3.4); dataset construction described but release not confirmed

notes: NAACL 2025 industry track. All GPT-4-turbo/GPT-4o bias and matching results are reported only as approximate figure readings (e.g. 'around 0.90'); the only precise percentages in prose (60%, 80%, 20%, 40%) are for LLaMA-1, not the live models.
